correctness.rationale: The 3-state Greenberg–Hastings update on K_{m,n} minus a designated edge reduces exactly, for all m,n>=2, to distinguished endpoint colors plus two nonempty ordinary-shore color supports, a finite quotient of 3^2(2^3-1)^2=441 signatures. Every periodic quotient cycle (41 signatures) was checked to return each tracked ordinary color individually, avoiding the common error of confusing support-period with labeled trajectory period. Exhaustive finite quotient transition analysis gives 15 first-entry/least-period classes, max first entry 5, periods 1,3,4, and coefficient matrix of the fifth-entry class [[10,2,0],[2,0,0],[0,0,0]]. Inclusion-exclusion for surjection counts s_j(m-1)s_k(n-1) lifts exactly, yielding N_{5,1}=2^m+2^n+2 and F^17=F^5. Independent alternate quotient enumeration confirms all 441 states and periodic lifting. Intact biclique quotient has max first entry four. This is an all-size finite-state proof, not extrapolation from small m,n.
